breed.appearance: A small, lightly built tricolor dog with a mostly white, slightly scruffy medium-short coat, a large black patch on the shoulder/side, and faint gray-tan ticking on the legs and paws. breed.fun_fact: Chihuahuas pack a huge personality into a tiny body and often form deep, devoted bonds with their favorite people!
